skill.summary: Defines, manages, and enforces AI agent constitutions detailing mandates, permissions, prohibitions, performance, escalation, and succession protocols for go...

latestVersion.changelog:
### Skill update clarifies scope and usage—framework only, no API/data

- Added explanation that this skill serves as a conceptual framework for agent constitutions, not an operational API or storage layer.
- Clarified that all constitution creation/amendment happens through the Umnix web platform, with no credentials or data managed by the skill itself.
- Refined use cases to focus on learning, planning, and best practices rather than implementation details.
- Removed technical implementation, schema, and compliance monitoring logic from documentation, concentrating on governance concepts and constitutional patterns.
- Audience now gains a clearer understanding of when (and when not) to use the skill.
